claims.statement: Lead capture happens in the Zalo webhook path: candidate_extraction.py runs an LLM call returning structured CRM fields + memory facts, normalize_lead() applies Vietnamese diacritic-insensitive normalization, extract_self_reported_name() pulls name from message text. New leads get lead_stage=NEW.
LeadStage enum: NEW → CONTACTING → REGISTERED / SKIPPED. LeadScore enum: hot / warm / not_interested. Stages map to Vietnamese: Mới, Đang liên hệ, Đã đăng ký, Bỏ qua.

LeadService.board() groups leads into kanban sections: 'Cần trả lời' (needs_reply, priority), then NEW, CONTACTING, REGISTERED, SKIPPED. Sorting: hot → warm → not_interested, then by requested column. The needs_reply section uses attention ordering: unanswered conversation → due follow-up → hot score.

LeadService.update uses optimistic concurrency: incoming version compared to DB row version, ConflictError on mismatch, version += 1 on success, publish lead.updated event. No version = trusted internal callers apply direct updates.

OA profile enrichment runs on persistence_low queue after each SENT reply. Rate-limited: PROFILE_LOOKUP_DONE_TTL_SECONDS=7 days, PROFILE_LOOKUP_LOCK_TTL_SECONDS=15s, PROFILE_LOOKUP_WAIT_SECONDS=3.0s. Stores display name on Contact, not directly on Lead.

LeadEventBus publishes 'lead.updated' via publish_event to lead:<lead_id> rooms. ChatopsService provides quick-actions: mark_contacting, schedule_followup, mark_not_interested, mark_registered. build_assist constructs the assist panel with summary, missing fields, suggested reply, next action.

Lead list supports: stage filter, needs_reply/exclude_needs_reply, zalo_id/zalo_ids, q (Vietnamese unaccent search across name/phone/desired_job/zalo_id). Sort by: updated_at, created_at, name, lead_stage, lead_score. Viewer-scoped via viewer_scope_filter.
